player_prompt.intro:
O tla bona {N} maadima a afitlhelwang ka tatelano.
Mo kgaolong nngwe le nngwe, kwala [accept] go tlhopha maadima a *jaanong*, goba [continue] go a goga mme o bone a mangwe.
Fa o sa tlhopheng, o tla tlhophiwa maadima a bofelo.
O tla fenya (tuelo = 1) **fela** fa maadima a o tlhophileng a le a magolo mo go tsotlhe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kgato e tshwanetse go nna [accept] kgotsa [continue].

outcome.summary: O tlhophilwe maadima {value} mo go tlhageng {draw_num}/{N}. A magolo mo go tsotlhe e ne e le {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: Ke tshwetso e e molemo tota!
outcome.not_max: Ga se gore ke a bo a le kwa godimo.
